datasheet_identity.title: SS32B THRU SS320B Surface Mount Schottky Barrier Rectifier

extraction_notes: The datasheet is a family sheet; SS310B is the 100 V variant with VRRM = 100 V, VRMS = 70 V, and VDC = 100 V on p. 1.
Fig. 3 provides a grouped SS38B-SS310B typical forward curve rather than an individually separated SS310B trace; digitized points retain that group semantics.

Fig. 4 provides a grouped SS38B-SS320B typical reverse curve rather than an individually separated SS310B trace; digitized points retain the group semantics and the plotted Tj = 25 degC and Tj = 100 degC conditions.
No self-heating: junction temperature is fixed at TNOM. Thermal derating from the datasheet is not modelled.
Package parasitics (lead inductance, package capacitance) are not modelled.
Fitted at 25 C only. Temperature coefficients XTI and EG are at physical defaults unless a temperature sweep was fitted.
Schottky majority-carrier device: no minority-carrier storage, TT is zero by construction.
Junction capacitance is represented from one tabulated point at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz; VJ and M are held at physical defaults, so capacitance versus reverse bias is approximate.
Reverse breakdown is not modelled: BV is absent, so the model conducts only leakage above the rated VRRM.
Flicker noise is not modelled: KF and AF are at defaults (no noise data published).
